final_review: Actual saved-native and independent GLB keep the narrow rear-left mineral mast/copper stalk over a low right-projecting foundation, one upper vertical blue inset and exactly four lower amber-red status cells. Source-specific feedback broadens/flattens knuckles into a thick ore bed and adds warm cell cores. A final whole-silhouette comparison restored the previously too-low foundation height and too-thin mast, while the copper trace remains subtler than the concept. All surfaces/texture pixels match and detail renders come from the same canonical geometry.
limitations: Exact hidden sections, mineral profiles, copper joint engineering and wear are authored from limited original views.
No operating motion is demonstrated by this building sprite/catalogue. Improved-sensors research depicts a separate generic housing; its rotating presentation does not establish Mikotaj motion.
Final user artistic acceptance, client state/scale/shaders and Android performance remain separate.
